_about: Screenshots ads may use. Taken by shoot.js from a throwaway copy of the app. Coordinates are in the screenshot's own pixels (1580 wide). 'ticker: true' means a real stock symbol is visible, so check.js blocks that shot: TikTok's US ad policy bans ads for single securities.

school-liquidity.shows: Hands-on order book demo (send a market buy)

puzzle.shows: Candle puzzle, mystery stock, nothing picked

puzzle-picked.shows: Candle puzzle, mystery stock, 'Tweezer top' picked

puzzle-solved.shows: Solved puzzle revealing the stock symbol

library.shows: Pattern library grid with real stats per pattern

library-hammer.shows: Hammer detail page with 'what really happened' stats (51% vs 53% any day)
